paragraphs.text: For Model III: We modeled three different strategies - "energy", "environment", "hu- man security" and related factors respectively, and finally obtained the feasibility of inter- vention scenarios through coupling coordination analysis, And the final evaluation value of the three aspects is calculated through the secondary indicators after the intervention.
